row.notes: Mode-0 owner switch (one shared tree, owner cache U+0x1aa8): runs Career_Eval_UpgradeAvailability (@0x14352e66d) and writes the state byte of each instance's last entry directly, bypassing Career_Push_UpgradeState and its dept gate. Mode-0 availability pass for one owner (what Career_Query_EnabledUpgrades runs when the owner cache +0x1aa8 differs): per tree-0 instance Career_Eval_UpgradeAvailability writes the latest entry's state byte, 0x14352ea40 recomputes its facility lock (+0xd) from unlock_at_facility_level (+0x74) against the team's kind-4 modifier sum for the department (not locked when the level is < 1 or the state is 2..4); if 0x14352eb30 says so, every Available becomes Unavailable; stores owner in +0x1aa8.

verify.notes: V0309 Independent: rcx upgrades, edx owner; per tree-0 (+0x110, count +0xd10) instance 0x14352e720 result written to latest entry +8 and 0x14352ea40 result to +0xd directly (no Push); 0x14352eb30 true -> every latest Available(1) set Unavailable(0); +0x1aa8 = owner; Career_Query_EnabledUpgrades calls it in mode 0 when owner != none and differs from +0x1aa8 (same gate at all 5 callers). Wording note: 0x14352ea40 keeps the current +0xd when the team has no kind-4 modifier for the department.
